en-US.summary: Control Skylight reward points with your voice
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask skylight points to give Lily three points
Alexa, ask skylight points to reward Jack a point
Alexa, ask skylight points to deduct two points from James
en-US.name: Skylight Points
en-US.description: Voice-control Skylight reward points for your kids. Give or deduct points for Lily, James, or Jack using simple voice commands.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Use the sample utterances to test giving and deducting points.
